title: How unbreakable is Iran's regime? Tehran defiant despite deepening hardship for citizens
summary: Iran's economy may be teetering on the brink of collapse, but does that really threaten its regime? Monday's flare-up of hostilities across the Strait of Hormuz makes clear that oil's not about to start flowing freely again.
